decisions.reason: The naval vessel lighting line remains a defensible, certification-heavy specialist offer in demanding environments, so management would usually keep it unless volumes disappoint.
This general interior luminaire sits in the firm's core building-lighting range and is therefore likely to stay, though mainstream portfolio pruning is always possible.
As a flagship pendant luminaire that reflects the firm's optical and workplace-lighting direction, it is very unlikely to be withdrawn now.
The marine HMI searchlight is the least aligned with the firm's LED- and sustainability-led strategy, so management would likely redeploy resources away from it.
The marine searchlight still fits the firm's specialist transport and harsh-environment business, making retention more likely than withdrawal.
